mapper.select: SELECT c.strategy_version, c.tokenizer, c.updated_at AS chunked_at, c.child_tokens, c.parent_tokens, c.overlap_tokens, c.boundary_lookback_characters, c.parent_count, c.child_count FROM document_chunk_result c JOIN document_parse_result p ON p.document_id = c.document_id AND p.document_version = c.document_version WHERE c.document_id = #{id} AND c.document_version = #{version} AND c.updated_at >= p.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE document_chunk SET deleted = true WHERE document_id = #{id} AND document_version = #{version} AND deleted = false
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO document_chunk(id, document_id, document_version, knowledge_base_id, department_id, parent_chunk_id, parent_type, chunk_type, chunk_index, content, token_count, page_number, chapter, section, metadata, keyword_text,keyword_analyzer,keyword_content_hash) VALUES
(#{row.id}, #{row.documentId}, #{row.documentVersion}, #{row.knowledgeBaseId}, #{row.departmentId}, #{row.parentChunkId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, CASE WHEN #{row.chunkType} = 'CHILD' THEN 'PARENT' ELSE NULL END, #{row.chunkType}, #{row.chunkIndex}, #{row.content}, #{row.tokenCount}, #{row.pageNumber,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{row.chapter,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.section,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{row.metadataJson} AS jsonb), #{row.keywordText},#{row.keywordAnalyzer},encode(sha256(convert_to(#{row.content},'UTF8')),'hex'))
ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET parent_chunk_id = excluded.parent_chunk_id, parent_type = excluded.parent_type, content = excluded.content, token_count = excluded.token_count, page_number = excluded.page_number, chapter = excluded.chapter, section = excluded.section, metadata = excluded.metadata, deleted = false, embedding = NULL, embedding_model = NULL, embedding_dimensions = NULL, embedding_content_hash = NULL, keyword_text=excluded.keyword_text,keyword_analyzer=excluded.keyword_analyzer, keyword_content_hash=excluded.keyword_content_hash

INSERT INTO document_chunk_result(document_id, document_version, strategy_version, tokenizer, child_tokens, parent_tokens, overlap_tokens, boundary_lookback_characters, parent_count, child_count) VALUES (#{id}, #{version}, #{strategy}, #{tokenizer}, #{config.childTokens}, #{config.parentTokens}, #{config.overlapTokens}, #{config.boundaryLookbackCharacters}, #{parents}, #{children}) ON CONFLICT(document_id, document_version) DO UPDATE SET strategy_version = excluded.strategy_version, tokenizer = excluded.tokenizer, child_tokens = excluded.child_tokens, parent_tokens = excluded.parent_tokens, overlap_tokens = excluded.overlap_tokens, boundary_lookback_characters = excluded.boundary_lookback_characters, parent_count = excluded.parent_count, child_count = excluded.child_count
